instruction.name: revh.2w
instruction.description: Reverse the two 16-bit halfwords within each of the two 32-bit words.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: revh.2w $r12, $r4; revh.2w $r13, $r5; revh.2w $r14, $r6; revh.2w $r15, $r7; revh.2w $r16, $r8; revh.2w $r17, $r9; revh.2w $r18, $r10; revh.2w $r19, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8' --asm 'revh.2w $r12, $r4; revh.2w $r13, $r5; revh.2w $r14, $r6; revh.2w $r15, $r7; revh.2w $r16, $r8; revh.2w $r17, $r9; revh.2w $r18, $r10; revh.2w $r19, $r11'
